title: SmokeTestResult
description: Structured outcome record of a smoke test execution containing timing, throughput, and shard sizing.

success.description: True if training executed without errors; False on any failure.

sample_count.description: Number of dataset samples processed during the benchmark.

training_time_seconds.description: Elapsed training execution time in seconds measured by monotonic clock (null on failure).

samples_per_second.description: Calculated training throughput in samples per second (null on failure).

shard_training_time_limit_seconds.description: Maximum desired shard training duration budget used for sizing.

estimated_samples_per_shard.description: Theoretical maximum sample capacity for a single shard (null on failure).

recommended_samples_per_shard.description: Recommended partition capacity incorporating configured safety margin (null on failure).

error.description: Detailed error message and diagnostics if training failed (null on success).
